messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx error rate detected from Dedicated pool 'dedicated-citr-prod' affecting tenant citrine-prod (Citrine Health). Error spike started ~2026-03-15T02:03:20Z. Auto-fallback attempted to safe variant but saw increased latency. Pager routed to oncall-sre.

jamie: oncall here, looking now. Confirming scope: is this across all models or only the pinned model for the tenant?

maria: seeing elevated 503s for the pinned model version `citrine-llama-2-v1.4-pin` only. Other tenants on the pool look ok. Customer reported degraded responses 5m ago.

alex: checking infra metrics — GPU mem/pinning looks healthy. But we see KV cache thrash for tenant's long context windows. Maybe cache pressure + batching causing OOM spikes on a subset of nodes.

kevin: reached out to customer (Citrine Health) in parallel; they're seeing timeouts in production affecting claims-processing flow. They want ETA and whether we can pin them to a smaller context model or safe variant.

jamie: ack. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Rate-limit large-context requests from that tenant to prevent KV thrash. 2) Shift routing for citrine-prod to their safe variant `citrine-safe-variant-v1` (lower context window, quantized) as a fallback. 3) If safe variant acceptable, keep pinned but set automatic rollback to safe variant on error >5% for 2 minutes.

maria: I can coordinate model-level changes. Suggest command to pin safe variant and force traffic over canary nodes first:

```
# canary 20% then promote
redwoodctl routing set --tenant citrine-prod --route canary --model citrine-safe-variant-v1 --weight 20
# pin override for entire tenant if canary stable
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant citrine-prod --model citrine-safe-variant-v1 --reason "mitigate 5xx spikes"
```

jamie: before pinning, let's apply a quick rate-limit rule to blunt the spike. `alex` can you push a temporary policy?

alex: pushing policy now. Command:

```
redwoodctl policies create --tenant citrine-prod --name "emergency-kv-rate" --type rate-limit --value "80r/s" --scope requests>4k
```

alex: policy applied to ingress layer, should take effect within 20s. :white_check_mark:

opsbot: Deployment note: Routing change to `citrine-safe-variant-v1` will cause model warming; expect initial latency bump ~3-7s.

lee: from customer-eng: we asked Citrine if they accept visible degradation for 10-20m while we stabilize; they prefer fallback rather than continued errors. Ops, proceed with safe variant if oncall approves.

jamie: agree to proceed. Maria, start canary then promote if stable for 5 minutes. I'll watch error budget and eviction events.

maria: canary started 20% to canary nodes for citrine-prod at 2273345155. Monitoring logs for 5xx and latency.

incident-bot: DETECT: canary error_rate=1.6% (baseline 0.2%), avg_latency=1.8s. Continuing to observe.

maria: error rate dropping to 0.4% after warmup, latency steady. Promoting to full pin in 2m if no regression.

kevin: updating customer: "We've routed a fallback variant and are monitoring. Expect normal service within ~10 minutes; will confirm once stabilized." :thumbsup:

incident-bot: ACTION LOG: rate-limit policy applied by alex at 2273345120; canary route applied by maria at 2273345155.

jamie: I see a node with repeated KV cache evictions at 2273345240 — taking that node out of rotation to prevent ripple. Marking node id gpu-rc-14 for maintenance.

alex: removed gpu-rc-14 from LB pool and draining connections. Starting replacement warm node.

maria: full tenant pin to `citrine-safe-variant-v1` at 2273345320. Backup: set automatic rollback threshold 5xx > 3% for 120s.

incident-bot: NOTIFICATION: automatic rollback configured for tenant citrine-prod.

jamie: current status: 5xx rate down to 0.1%, latencies within SLA for safe variant. We mitigated immediate customer impact. Still investigating root cause (KV cache management + long contexts on pinned model).

lee: customer confirms they see degraded but successful responses, much better than errors. They're fine with safe variant for now, will coordinate internal retry handling.

kevin: scheduling post-incident call with Citrine at 1500 PST to explain tradeoffs and next steps (model tuning, context limits). I'll invite product and SE.

maria: follow-ups for action items: 1) add tenant-specific KV cache quota for long contexts; 2) evaluate model memory usage pattern for `citrine-llama-2-v1.4-pin`; 3) add canary test that simulates long-context traffic for pinned tenants.

jamie: leaving a short handoff for night oncall (sarah) — summary below.

jamie: HANDOFF -> sarah: Incident 2273345000: Citrine Health (citrine-prod) had 5xx spike due to KV cache thrash on pinned model. Mitigations: emergency rate-limit, canary route to citrine-safe-variant-v1 then full pin, drained problematic node gpu-rc-14. Status: stabilized, 5xx back to 0.1%, automatic rollback in place. Open action items: tenant KV quota, model mem analysis, post-incident customer call. Pager retained for 2h for regressions.

sarah: acknowledged, will take over monitoring and escalate if we see rollback or new spikes. :eyes:

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED: monitoring-only phase started at 2273345720. If new errors exceed thresholds, the thread will reopen and page the oncall."
